name: Hike steep with pack 65
description: A long steady steep climb for pack-carrying days. Wear a real pack if you like, but body weight plus pack must stay within the W1 limit of 120 kg.

ramp.name: Warm-up
ramp.notes: Easy and smooth. Nose breathing, shoulders loose.

steps.name: Steep steady
steps.notes: RPE 5. Poles in hand if you will use them outdoors.

ramp.name: Cooldown
ramp.notes: Let the breathing settle; sip water.
